title: Save national forests near Yellowstone, Grand Teton, and the Appalachian Trail from Trump!
text:
Petition to Congress: We urge you to speak out and stop the Trump administration from rolling back the Roadless Rule. Please act to protect America’s national forests.

Trump advanced a plan to gut federal forest protections — a direct threat to the natural lands and animal life near Yellowstone National Park, Grand Teton, and the Appalachian trail.1

The Trump administration wants to hand over 45 million acres of public land, including native ancestral homelands, to the highest bidder. It will lead to the corporate destruction of forests, critical biodiversity, clean water sources, and wildlife.2,3

Congress must act now to protect America's cherished parks, lands, and environment from Trump's profiteering oligarchy.

Sign the petition: Block Trump's plan to open up national forests around Yellowstone for corporate development!

The Trump administration is preparing to fully rescind the "Roadless Rule," a federal regulation that has protected tens of millions of acres of national forests for over two decades.4

Senator Martin Heinrich said in response, "Without the Roadless Rule, many of the treasured landscapes, public lands, and habitats that we know and love simply wouldn’t exist today."5

Congress must act now to protect national forests from destruction at the hands of corporate developers and the White House.

Sign the petition: Don't let Trump roll back the Roadless Rule!
